name: docker-wakeup-dev
description: Repository-wide development tooling for DockerWakeUp: lint, type checks, tests and CI. The deployable packages are wake-proxy/ and proxy-generator/, each with its own package.json.

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix wake-proxy && npm ci --prefix proxy-generator
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p wake-proxy/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p proxy-generator/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run shellcheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:setup-script
